decisions.tests: Existing tests edited, none weakened: ux-move.spec.ts now matches the exact action name 'Accept or decline' (a waiting row's own sentence contains those words and is a row link whose accessible name is its visible text, WCAG 2.5.3, which axe enforces); ux-teaching-layer.test.ts lists home-work.tsx among the screens that mount the mr components, as the test itself says each lane must.
decisions.oneFilledAction: The header's New request is the only filled in-page-visible action on Home and Move. Card actions, the start link and the next-step row are secondary or quiet.
decisions.owner: Active work rows show Kind, Status and Date. A work item has no owner field, so no owner column is invented; the Move page's waiting rows do show who holds them.
decisions.stage: The stage bar reads the same marker as the Road. Compare and Decide with no record are plain grey segments with no words. The Road itself (request room, programme room) is unchanged in this PR.
decisions.requests: The Requests page is not changed here: its tabs, filter and workspaces table are CX PR 2b, after the shared sub-tabs lands.
decisions.titleCase: Minor words (a, an, the, and, or, of, to, in, on, for, by, at) stay lowercase unless first; every other word starts with a capital, so 'as' becomes 'As'. The text itself changed, never text-transform. Placeholders such as {count} and words already capitalised are left alone. Navigation destinations, headings, text links and disclosure summaries are not buttons and are not changed; the programme pages under account/delegations belong to another track and are not changed.
decisions.testsEdited: Exact-name assertions in 12 operator specs and 6 integration tests follow the new words with the same assertions. The saved-report golden changed only in two button labels (Send Response, Refresh Approved Commercial Report). Prose that contains 'Try again' (the shared limit sentence, load-failure lines) is unchanged; a first scripted replacement touched it and was reverted. ux-move.spec.ts matches the exact action name 'Accept or Decline'. ux-teaching-layer.test.ts lists home-work.tsx as a screen that mounts the mr components.
decisions.alignment: Row text and column heads start at the content's left edge: the row link's hover surface reaches left with a negative start margin, so the words align with headings and the right side stays inside the column. A first version pulled both sides and caused 12 px of sideways scroll in ux-move and ux-pseudo-language; fixed to the start side only.
